name: io.github.adamVass/pylos-mcp
title: pylos-mcp
description: Email MCP server for Gmail, Outlook and any IMAP mailbox, hardened against prompt injection

environmentVariables.name: EMAIL_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: App password. Either this or EMAIL_PASSWORD_CMD is required, except with PROVIDER=outlook, which signs in through the browser.

environmentVariables.name: PROVIDER
environmentVariables.description: One of gmail, outlook, icloud, yahoo, gmx, fastmail, mailbox.org, posteo. Fills in IMAP, SMTP and Sieve hosts and ports.

environmentVariables.name: IMAP_HOST
environmentVariables.description: IMAP hostname for self-hosted or unlisted providers. Overrides the preset.

environmentVariables.name: CAPABILITIES
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated list of tiers beyond read, which is always included. Defaults to drafts.

environmentVariables.name: MS_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: With PROVIDER=outlook only. Application ID of an app registered in your organization's tenant.

environmentVariables.name: MS_TENANT
environmentVariables.description: With PROVIDER=outlook only. Tenant ID or domain, for a single-tenant MS_CLIENT_ID.
